reply_text:
I answered Marcus in his direct message. All three answers came from places he can see himself.

- **Osprey site:** Dock 37. Ilse posted this in #north-team on 14 Oct.
- **Osprey deadline:** 26 August, but the year is unclear. Dana posted the date in #north-random on 14 Oct without a year, and 26 August 2026 had already passed by then. Back then I asked her whether she meant 2027 and found no reply. I've told Marcus to check with her before he puts it in the handover.
- **Door 6 duplicate arrivals:** the contact is Thea Ramaswell, Quarrendon Freight Lines' Director of Yard Operations and their main contact. She reported the morning-shift duplicates: the driver checked in at the kiosk, then dispatch added the same trailer again by hand (#north-team, 20 Aug 2025).

The reply contains no money terms and nothing from anyone else's direct messages, so no approval was needed.
